https://saref.etsi.org/core/hasApplicabl.description: Links an entity (e.g., a profile) to an instant or interval or other compound temporal entity expressed using OWL Time, which bounds temporally the applicable context of that entity.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/hasInput.description: Links a command, operation, or procedure execution, to its inputs.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/hasOptionalC.description: Links a function and one of its optional commands

https://saref.etsi.org/core/hasOutput.description: Links a command or operation to its outputs.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/hasPhenomeno.description: Links a procedure execution to the time that the result applies. It may be an interval or an instant, or some other compound temporal entity expressed using OWL Time.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/hasResult.description: Links a procedure execution (e.g., an observation) to its result (e.g., a property value).

https://saref.etsi.org/core/profileHasPr.description: Links a profile to the money earned (negative values) or paid (positive values) for the use (production or consumption) of the commodity by the device

https://saref.etsi.org/core/whenProperty.description: Links a profile to a property value that contributes to restricting its applicable context.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/whenState.description: Links a profile to a state that contributes to restricting its applicable context.

https://saref.etsi.org/saref4bldg/nomina.description: The maximum and minimum allowed voltage of the supply e.g. boundaries of 380V/440V may be applied for a nominal voltage of 400V.

https://saref.etsi.org/saref4bldg/shortC.description: A complex number that specifies the real and imaginary parts of the short-circuit voltage at rated current of a transformer given in %.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/accomplishes.description: Links a certain entity (e.g., a device) to the task it accomplishes.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/consumes.description: Links a feature kind, feature of interest, or device, to the commodity it consumes

https://saref.etsi.org/core/hasDeviceKin.description: Links a device to its kind, a device kind. Kinds of devices describe models of devices, with common properties and common states having the same value, targeting the same properties and states, common functions, and common services.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/hasOperation.description: Links a service to one of its operations.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/hasProfile.description: Links a device to its profile. Its inverse is saref:isProfileOf. The device should be linked to a certain commodity using OP saref:consumes, saref:produces, or saref:stores, and optionally to some property or state using OP saref:targets or its sub-properties.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/hasPropertyV.description: Links a feature kind, a feature of interest, or a property of interest, to a property value.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/hasStateValu.description: Links a feature kind, a feature of interest, or a state of interest, to a state value.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/isAccomplish.description: A relationship identifying an entity (e.g., a device) that can accomplish a task.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/isCommandOf.description: Links a command and a function or function of interest that supports it.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/isConsumedBy.description: Links a commodity to the feature kind, feature of interest, or device, that consumes it

https://saref.etsi.org/core/isControlled.description: Links a feature, property, or state, to the device, function, command, or procedure execution, that controls it.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/isFunctionOf.description: Links a function to the feature kind or device it is a function of.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/isMeasuredIn.description: A relationship identifying the unit of measure used for a certain entity.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/isObservedBy.description: Links a feature, property, or state, to the device, function, command, or procedure execution, that observes it.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/isProducedBy.description: Links a commodity to the feature kind, feature of interest, or device, that produces it

https://saref.etsi.org/core/isProfileOf.description: Links a profile to the device it describes. The device should be linked to a certain commodity using OP saref:consumes, saref:produces, or saref:stores, and optionally to some property or state using OP saref:targets or its sub-properties.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/isPropertyOf.description: Links a property to the feature kind or feature of interest it is a property of.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/isStateOf.description: Links a state to the feature kind or feature of interest it is a state of.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/isStoredBy.description: Links a commodity to the feature kind, feature of interest, or device, that stores it

https://saref.etsi.org/core/madeExecutio.description: Links an entity (e.g., device) to the procedure execution it made.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/offers.description: Links a device to a service it exposes to a network.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/produces.description: Links a feature kind, feature of interest, or device, to the commodity it produces

https://saref.etsi.org/core/stores.description: Links a feature kind, feature of interest, or device, to the commodity it stores

https://saref.etsi.org/core/hasCommandOf.description: Links a function of interest to one of its commands of interest.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/hasFunctionK.description: links a function of interest to its kind, a function

https://saref.etsi.org/core/hasFunctionO.description: Links a device to one of its functions of interest.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/hasMandatory.description: Links a function and one of its mandatory commands

https://saref.etsi.org/core/hasPropertyO.description: Links a feature of interest to one of its properties of interest.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/hasStateOfIn.description: Links a feature of interest to one of its states of interest.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/isCommandOfI.description: Links a command of interest to the function of interest it is a command of.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/isFunctionOf.description: Links a function of interest to the device it is a function of.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/isOfferedBy.description: Links a service to the device that exposes it to a network

https://saref.etsi.org/core/isOperationO.description: Links an operation to the service it belongs to.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/isPropertyOf.description: Links a property of interest to the feature of interest it is a property of.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/isStateOfInt.description: Links a state of interest to the feature of interest it is a state of.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/isTargetOf.description: Links a feature, property, or state, to the device, function, command, or procedure execution, that targets it.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/isValueOfPro.description: Links a property value to the property or property of interest it is a value of.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/isValueOfSta.description: Links a state value to the state or state of interest it is a value of.

https://saref.etsi.org/saref4bldg/isCont.description: A relation between a physical object and the physical space in which it is contained.

https://saref.etsi.org/saref4bldg/isSpac.description: Relation between a building space and the building or building space it belongs to.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/controls.description: Links a device, function, command, or procedure execution, to the feature, property, or state, it controls.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/hasCommand.description: Links a function or function of interest and the command it supports.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/hasCommandKi.description: links a command of interest to its kind, a command.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/hasFunction.description: Links a feature kind or a device to one of its functions.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/hasState.description: Links a feature kind or a feature of interest to one of its states.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/madeBy.description: Links a procedure execution to the entity (e.g., device) that made it.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/targets.description: Links a device, function, command, or procedure execution, to the feature, property, or state, it targets.

https://saref.etsi.org/saref4bldg/contai.description: A relation between a physical object and another physical object it contains.

https://saref.etsi.org/saref4bldg/hasSpa.description: Relation between a building or a building space and the spaces it can be divided into.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/hasPropertyK.description: links a property of interest to its kind, a property.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/hasStateKind.description: links a state of interest to its kind, a state

https://saref.etsi.org/core/isExecutionO.description: Links a command execution to the command or command of interest that was executed. Also liks an operation execution to the operation that was executed

https://saref.etsi.org/core/observes.description: Links a device, function, command, or procedure execution, to the feature, property, or state, it observes.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/represents.description: Links a service to some function or function of interest it exposes to the network. Also links an operation to some command or command of interest it exposes to the network.

https://saref.etsi.org/core/hasFeatureKi.description: links a feature of interest to its kind, a feature kind

https://saref.etsi.org/core/consistsOf.description: A relationship indicating a composite entity that consists of other entities (e.g., a temperature/humidity sensor that consists of a temperature sensor and a humidity sensor)

https://saref.etsi.org/core/hasProperty.description: Links a feature kind or a feature of interest to one of its properties.
